summary.caption: Cinematic two-page design-magazine feature about regenerative architecture, combining a continuous living-building photograph, translucent technical overlays, oversized editorial typography and precise small text in moss green, mineral white and safety orange.

items.label: object
items.caption: One continuous ultra-wide editorial photograph spanning both pages: a radical timber research building overtaken by lush vegetation and mist, interior rooms visible through glass, tiny people for scale, dramatic soft daylight, premium architecture-magazine realism.

items.label: text
items.caption: Tiny safety-orange uppercase section marker with wide tracking in the top-left margin.

items.label: text
items.caption: Monumental condensed mineral-white headline stacked across the left page, partly overlaying dark foliage while remaining perfectly legible.

items.label: object
items.caption: Fine translucent white technical cutaway lines and numbered botanical callouts over the right-page architecture, showing water, airflow and habitat loops like a sophisticated scientific diagram.

items.label: text
items.caption: Elegant warm-white standfirst on a translucent dark-moss rectangle, left aligned on the right page.
items.text:
A new generation of architecture
does more than shelter life —
it becomes part of the ecosystem.

items.text: Can a building clean water, grow food and restore habitat? Inside the experimental studios turning architecture into a living participant.
